items.name: EXTENSION_TYPE_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: The metadata key for a serialized representation of the [`ExtensionType`] necessary to reconstruct the custom type.

items.name: EXTENSION_TYPE_NAME_KEY
items.summary: The metadata key for the string name identifying an [`ExtensionType`].

methods.name: deserialize_metadata
methods.summary: Deserialize the metadata of this extension type from the serialized representation of the metadata. An extension type that defines no metadata should expect `None` for the serialized metadata and return `Ok(())`.

methods.name: metadata
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the metadata of this extension type, or `&()` if if this extension type defines no metadata (`Self::Metadata=()`).

methods.name: serialize_metadata
methods.summary: Returns the serialized representation of the metadata of this extension type, or `None` if this extension type defines no metadata (`Self::Metadata=()`).

methods.name: supports_data_type
methods.summary: Returns `Ok(())` iff the given data type is supported by this extension type.

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(data_type: &DataType, metadata: Self::Metadata) -> Result<Self, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Construct this extension type for a field with the given data type and metadata.

methods.name: try_new_from_field_metadata
methods.signature: fn try_new_from_field_metadata(data_type: &DataType, metadata: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Result<Self, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Construct this extension type from field metadata and data type.

methods.name: validate
methods.signature: fn validate(data_type: &DataType, metadata: Self::Metadata) -> Result<(), ArrowError>
methods.summary: Validate this extension type for a field with the given data type and metadata.
